label: pairwise_artist_signature_camera_composition_010
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, facial profile, and visible profile eye clearly readable. The second camera direction is the measured axis. Obey its literal crop, side view, field of view, asymmetric placement, and negative-space counterweight. Create a clean hand-drawn two-dimensional editorial illustration. The exact name-free signature controls the visible medium, face, eyes, silhouette, palette, light, composition, and ornament. Make these eight cues bold and unmistakable: line language—bold broken dry-brush contours with visible gaps around the entire silhouette and seams; face design—a short compact oval face; eye design—deep almond eyes with heavy upper rims; body design—a balanced narrow silhouette visible at mid-thigh scale; palette language—clay, sand, olive, cream, and warm brown fields; light modeling—velvety diffuse values and soft contact shadows; framing language—a tall upright border with a low visual anchor, expressed in the background while the measured camera controls subject placement; ornament language—repeated textile bands and woven motifs. Draw face and eye details crisply within the mid-thigh figure. Put the ornament on both the garment and outer border. Keep the visible figure in front of every decorative framing element. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: Photograph an adult subject using thigh-up framing that preserves the waist, hand gesture, and garment silhouette from an eye-level frontal camera position with undistorted facial alignment. The view uses a natural perspective close to ordinary vision with balanced subject-to-background scale and asymmetric placement with generous negative space and one clear visual counterweight. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—make a tight thigh-up portrait. Let the figure fill most of the canvas from the complete crown to a hard lower image edge cutting through the middle of both thighs. Keep the face and any explicitly named visible hand gesture inside. Do not show knees, calves, shoes, feet, floor under the feet, or the complete legs.
